Bounds.description:
Integer screen bounds `[left, top, right, bottom]` in pixels.

Serialized as a four-element array. `right`/`bottom` are exclusive at the Android/UI-automator pixel-grid level.

FrameMeta.description:
Metadata for one produced frame.

A frame answers a *cause* (the request/action id that produced it) and has a monotonically increasing per-session `frame_seq`. `content_hash` is the SHA-256 of the encoded pixels. `meaningful` is false for blank/placeholder frames; a placeholder must never satisfy a UI assertion.

cause_id.description: The request id that caused this frame (for example `req_19`).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the encoded frame pixels (lowercase hex).

density.description: Display density in dots per inch.

display_origin.description:
Display-space coordinates of this frame's pixel `(0,0)`.

Absent means the frame covers the whole display and `(0,0)` is display `(0,0)` (the AOSP `screencap` case). A present value is authoritative: an agent must add it to convert a frame pixel into display coordinates, and subtract it for the reverse.

display_size.description: Full display size in pixels — the space `display_origin` and every UI tree bound are expressed in.

meaningful.description: True only when the frame reflects real rendered UI content.

produced_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the frame was produced by ACOS.

UiNode.description:
One UI node.

`id` is a tree-local stable node identity (for example `n7`), not the Android resource id; `resource_id` is the Android id.

bounds.description: Screen bounds in pixels (the view's full rect).

focused.description: Whether the node has input focus.

hint.description: `TextView.getHint()` (empty when absent); the placeholder an EditText shows while its text is empty.

id.description: Tree-local node id, stable for one tree snapshot.

visible.description: Whether the node is visible *to the user* (Android's `isVisibleToUser`: shown — it and all ancestors VISIBLE and attached — and its global visible rect, clipped by every ancestor and the window/display, is non-empty).

visible_bounds.description: The part of `bounds` the user can actually see: `bounds` clipped by every ancestor (scroll/pager clip) and by the window/display bounds, in screen pixels. `None` when the engine does not report it (older probes); use [`UiNode::visible_rect`] for the rect a tap may use.

window.description: Window this node belongs to (empty when the engine reports one window or predates multi-window probes). `bounds` is local to this window; `bounds_on_screen` is display space.

description: A snapshot of the UI tree for one frame.

text_available.description: False when the text/semantics route was unavailable.

truncated.description: True when any window of the tree was truncated by a node limit.
